158	// backupPath should contain the previous config files for rollback.
159	// Returns:
160	//   - nil on success
161	//   - ErrRollbackSucceeded wrapped with deployment error if rollback succeeded
162	//   - ErrRollbackFailed wrapped with both errors if rollback also failed
163	//   - Original error if no backup available
164	func (d *DeployOps) ComposeUpMultipleWithRollback(ctx context.Context, composeFiles []string, backupPath string) error {
165		logger := log.ComponentCtx(ctx, log.ComponentDeploy)
166	
167		upFn := d.composeUpFn
168		if upFn == nil {
169			upFn = d.ComposeUpMultiple
170		}
171	
172		deployErr := upFn(ctx, composeFiles)
173		if deployErr == nil {
174			return nil
175		}
176	
177		// Unhealthy containers are recoverable — skip rollback, return as warning.
178		if errors.Is(deployErr, ErrComposeUnhealthy) {
179			logger.Warn().
180				Err(deployErr).
181				Msg("Compose up completed with unhealthy containers, skipping rollback")
182			return deployErr
183		}
184	
185		// Compose failed - attempt rollback if backup exists
186		if backupPath == "" {
187			logger.Warn().
188				Err(deployErr).
189				Msg("Deployment failed, no backup available for rollback")
190			return fmt.Errorf("deployment failed (no backup available for rollback): %w", deployErr)
191		}
192	
193		logger.Warn().
194			Err(deployErr).
195			Str(log.FieldPath, backupPath).
196			Msg("Deployment failed, attempting rollback")
197	
198		// Build backup file list and verify they exist
199		var backupFiles []string
200		for _, f := range composeFiles {
201			backupFile := filepath.Join(backupPath, filepath.Base(f))
202			if _, statErr := os.Stat(backupFile); os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
203				// Skip missing backup files - they may be new stacks
204				continue
205			}
206			backupFiles = append(backupFiles, backupFile)
207		}
208	
209		if len(backupFiles) == 0 {
210			logger.Warn().
211				Str(log.FieldPath, backupPath).
212				Msg("No backup files found for rollback")
213			return fmt.Errorf("deployment failed (no backup files found for rollback): %w", deployErr)
214		}
215	
216		// Attempt rollback with independent timeout so it can execute even if ctx is cancelled.
217		// Copy enriched logger so reconcile_id flows into rollback logs.
218		rollbackCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
219			log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.Ctx(ctx)),
220			d.composeUpTimeout(),
221		)
222		defer cancel()
223	
224		// Build rollback args
225		args := d.composeUpArgs(backupFiles)
226	
227		rollbackCmd := exec.CommandContext(rollbackCtx, "docker", args...)
228		var rollbackStderr bytes.Buffer
229		rollbackCmd.Stderr = &rollbackStderr
230	
231		if rollbackErr := rollbackCmd.Run(); rollbackErr != nil {
232			// Both deployment and rollback failed - critical state
233			logger.Error().
234				Err(rollbackErr).
235				Str(log.FieldPath, backupPath).
236				Msg("CRITICAL: Rollback also failed")
237			return fmt.Errorf("%w: deployment error: %v, rollback error: %v", ErrRollbackFailed, deployErr, rollbackErr)
238		}
239	
240		// Rollback succeeded - return distinguishable error
241		logger.Info().
242			Str(log.FieldPath, backupPath).
243			Msg("Rollback completed successfully")
244		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrRollbackSucceeded, deployErr)

247	// ComposeUpIsolated runs compose up per-file with isolated failure handling.
248	// Phase 1: each file gets its own compose up (no --remove-orphans). On failure,
249	// the single file is rolled back from backup if available.
250	// Phase 2: a single orphan-reconciliation pass with all files and --remove-orphans.
251	func (d *DeployOps) ComposeUpIsolated(ctx context.Context, composeFiles []string, backupPath string) (*ComposeUpSummary, error) {
252		logger := log.ComponentCtx(ctx, log.ComponentDeploy)
253	
254		if d.DryRun {
255			logger.Debug().
256				Int("file_count", len(composeFiles)).
257				Msg("Dry run: would run isolated compose up per file")
258			results := make([]ComposeFileResult, len(composeFiles))
259			for i, f := range composeFiles {
260				results[i] = ComposeFileResult{File: f, Success: true}
261			}
262			summary := classifyComposeResults(results)
263			return &summary, nil
264		}
265	
266		upFn := d.composeUpFn
267		if upFn == nil {
268			// Clone DeployOps with RemoveOrphans disabled for Phase 1.
269			// Phase 1 runs each file individually — --remove-orphans would kill
270			// containers from other files not passed to the command.
271			noOrphanOps := *d
272			noOrphanOps.RemoveOrphans = false
273			upFn = noOrphanOps.ComposeUpMultiple
274		}
275	
276		// Phase 1: per-file compose up without --remove-orphans.
277		results := make([]ComposeFileResult, 0, len(composeFiles))
278		for _, f := range composeFiles {
279			logger.Info().
280				Str(log.FieldPath, f).
281				Msg("Starting isolated compose up for file")
282	
283			err := upFn(ctx, []string{f})
284			if err == nil {
285				results = append(results, ComposeFileResult{File: f, Success: true})
286				continue
287			}
288	
289			// Unhealthy-only is a warning, not a failure — treat as success.
290			if errors.Is(err, ErrComposeUnhealthy) {
291				logger.Warn().
292					Err(err).
293					Str(log.FieldPath, f).
294					Msg("Compose file has unhealthy containers, continuing")
295				results = append(results, ComposeFileResult{File: f, Success: true, Err: err})
296				continue
297			}
298	
299			// Real failure — attempt per-file rollback.
300			logger.Warn().
301				Err(err).
302				Str(log.FieldPath, f).
303				Msg("Compose up failed for file")
304	
305			rolledBack := false
306			if backupPath != "" {
307				backupFile := filepath.Join(backupPath, filepath.Base(f))
308				if _, statErr := os.Stat(backupFile); statErr == nil {
309					logger.Info().
310						Str(log.FieldPath, backupFile).
311						Msg("Rolling back single file from backup")
312	
313					rollbackCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
314						log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.Ctx(ctx)),
315						d.composeUpTimeout(),
316					)
317					rollbackArgs := d.buildUpArgs([]string{backupFile}, false)
318					rollbackCmd := exec.CommandContext(rollbackCtx, "docker", rollbackArgs...)
319					var rollbackStderr bytes.Buffer
320					rollbackCmd.Stderr = &rollbackStderr
321	
322					if rollbackErr := rollbackCmd.Run(); rollbackErr != nil {
323						logger.Error().
324							Err(rollbackErr).
325							Str(log.FieldPath, backupFile).
326							Msg("Per-file rollback failed")
327					} else {
328						logger.Info().
329							Str(log.FieldPath, backupFile).
330							Msg("Per-file rollback succeeded")
331						rolledBack = true
332					}
333					cancel()
334				}
335			}
336	
337			results = append(results, ComposeFileResult{File: f, Success: false, RolledBack: rolledBack, Err: err})
338		}
339	
340		summary := classifyComposeResults(results)
341	
342		// Phase 2: orphan reconciliation pass with all files.
343		if d.RemoveOrphans && summary.Succeeded > 0 {
344			orphanFiles := buildOrphanPassFiles(results, backupPath)
345			logger.Info().
346				Int("file_count", len(orphanFiles)).
347				Msg("Running orphan reconciliation pass")
348	
349			orphanArgs := d.buildUpArgs(orphanFiles, true)
350			orphanCtx, orphanCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, d.composeUpTimeout())
351			defer orphanCancel()
352			orphanCmd := exec.CommandContext(orphanCtx, "docker", orphanArgs...)
353			var orphanStderr bytes.Buffer
354			orphanCmd.Stderr = &orphanStderr
355	
356			if orphanErr := orphanCmd.Run(); orphanErr != nil {
357				logger.Warn().
358					Err(orphanErr).
359					Str("stderr", orphanStderr.String()).
360					Msg("Orphan reconciliation pass failed (non-fatal)")
361			} else {
362				logger.Info().Msg("Orphan reconciliation pass completed")
363			}
364		}
365	
366		// Determine overall error.
367		if len(composeFiles) > 0 && summary.Failed == len(composeFiles) {
368			return &summary, fmt.Errorf("all %d compose files failed to deploy", summary.Failed)
369		}
370	
371		return &summary, nil
372	}
